findings.details: Pinned HandModel source transform is scale then (x,y,z)->(x,-z,y), then visual origin, articulated saved FP32 frame and global pose. Independent reconstruction matches runtime geometric triangles exactly; target literal origins/scales match independently.
Palm/palm, wrist/wrist_carrier, ff/index,mf/middle,rf/ring,lf/little,th/thumb; runtime-excluded forearm consistently omitted from required common parts.

For every complete cube cell, 1-Lipschitz distance gives near iff d+rho+eps<=band and far iff d-rho-eps>band; lost/new masks and their outer bounds are consistent. Offsets2/5,1/3 give rho=sqrt181*h/15. Censor radius exceeds largestband+rho+eps. Positive lower areas refute equality; zero lower alone never passes.

Literal source one-box and target eight-box geometry are distinct from runtime visuals. Face subtraction removes buried/internal interfaces and retains exterior same-normal duplicates; signed boundary distance uses box-union membership. Occupancy masks conservatively exclude boundary uncertainty. Exact independent member-box obstruction bypasses this mesh/union distance implementation.

Frozen science max and SSE compare against original fixed-palm perpose baseline. Component method further limits maximum/SSE to fixed/free minima and adds mean guard. Relaxing only those extra strategy restrictions would not change original scientific criteria; however proof shows oldrow1 and newrow0 still obstructed under original criteria.

Independent exact-rational review confirms positive unavoidable palm occupancy mismatch for olddevelopmentrow1 and newnativerow0 under original max/SSE guards, all proper targetpalm placements and all fingerangles. This disproves cohort-wide exact acceptance, not allpossible poses or allapproximate mappings.
